<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="vorago" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Vorago</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/sY7JVkg9No.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="introduction"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Vorago is a high level group boss. He boasts high defence and complex mechanics that challenge even the best players. His unique drops include Tectonic Energies and Seismic equipment.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide is only an introduction + mechanics guide. For a beginner guide ‎ ‎use </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>, for DPS rotations, see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-general"><ins><nowiki>Presets - General</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-notes"><nowiki>General Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ New players </nowiki><em><nowiki>must</nowiki></em><nowiki> talk to Vorago and go through his dialogue options first before they can enter the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Select &quot;What are you doing here?&quot;, followed by &quot;Can I face you?&quot;</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once players reach the &quot;So, do we fight?&quot; dialogue, they are eligible to fight Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The default familiar is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442169053194.png?v=1" alt="bloodnihil" title="bloodnihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475441946230855.png?v=1" alt="shadownihil" title="shadownihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/854475442227642388.png?v=1" alt="smokenihil" title="smokenihil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for all combat styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Beast of Burden can be used, but is highly discouraged due to Vorago's massive defensive stats.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is immune to familiar damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are primarily used only once, during phase 5. They can also be spammed during damage-based phases.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="picking-a-combat-style"><nowiki>Picking A Combat Style</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>All three combat styles are viable at Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ranged and Melee are the strongest styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Magic is not far behind, and performs similarly to Ranged if Ranged does not have its expensive best-in-slot gear.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee can be difficult to use. Its range limitation applies several restrictions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not recommended for beginners</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee distance can cause less experienced players to take more damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unable to Bomb Tank in conventional teams</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="preset-notes"><nowiki>Preset Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A 1-dose </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used on most weeks for entry damage alone.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Multiple doses are required for Green Bomb, and highly recommended for Ceiling Collapse, Teamsplit, and The End.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to build adrenaline between phases for more damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Optional</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Often used with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689528927928188963.png?v=1" alt="greatgunkan" title="greatgunkan" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is eaten after taking entry damage to free up an inventory space for equipping 2H weapons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505116347105290.png?v=1" alt="berserker" title="berserker" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505153709965322.png?v=1" alt="mani" title="mani" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643505179378974748.png?v=1" alt="reckless" title="reckless" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are highly recommended due to Vorago's high defensive parameters.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other auras are discouraged, though supreme accuracy auras can be used.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Putting Turtling 3 over Turtling 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1" alt="turt4" title="turt4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on your t90 shield is recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The extra tick of Barricade </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073737377284146.png?v=1" alt="turt4" title="turt4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is irrelevant, and it can cause issues primarily with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown on The End P4 if mistimed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="rune-pouch-setup"><nowiki>Rune Pouch Setup</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656786565359599626.png?v=1" alt="blackpouch" title="blackpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune Pouch</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1" alt="Airrune" title="Airrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659586433024.png?v=1" alt="Deathrune" title="Deathrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1" alt="Earthrune" title="Earthrune" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656786565527502858.png?v=1" alt="bluepouch" title="bluepouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune Pouch</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658970001409.png?v=1" alt="Bloodrune" title="Bloodrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658961481769.png?v=1" alt="Astralrune" title="Astralrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659301089280.png?v=1" alt="Bodyrune" title="Bodyrune" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690848914638766082.png?v=1" alt="greenpouch" title="greenpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune Pouch</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1" alt="Waterrune" title="Waterrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659850674186.png?v=1" alt="Firerune" title="Firerune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659422855188.png?v=1" alt="Chaosrune" title="Chaosrune" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690848915020447745.png?v=1" alt="redpouch" title="redpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune Pouch</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252661406760970.png?v=1" alt="Lawrune" title="Lawrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659615924258.png?v=1" alt="Cosmicrune" title="Cosmicrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660333019136.png?v=1" alt="Soulrune" title="Soulrune" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656786565397348361.png?v=1" alt="pinkpouch" title="pinkpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Rune Pouch</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1" alt="Waterrune" title="Waterrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1" alt="Earthrune" title="Earthrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252658986647589.png?v=1" alt="Airrune" title="Airrune" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656786565397348361.png?v=1" alt="pinkpouch" title="pinkpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used for non-magic setups, and does not include </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To include </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for Scopulus, combine </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660165115905.png?v=1" alt="Waterrune" title="Waterrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659808731137.png?v=1" alt="Earthrune" title="Earthrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252660286881832.png?v=1" alt="Mudrune" title="Mudrune" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and add </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536252659422855188.png?v=1" alt="Chaosrune" title="Chaosrune" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Magic-specific spells: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090783567902.png?v=1" alt="incitefear" title="incitefear" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090745950258.png?v=1" alt="exsanguinate" title="exsanguinate" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Spells for all styles: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/859483781395120129.png?v=1" alt="sbsancients" title="sbsancients" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489467682816.png?v=1" alt="SBSLunars" title="SBSLunars" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1" alt="sd" title="sd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1" alt="HealOther" title="HealOther" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/657248051190300682.png?v=1" alt="borrowedpower" title="borrowedpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Only the Base Tank and Bomb Tank are required to bring these spells.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ For everyone else these spells are optional, but recommended in case of emergency</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Presets may change slightly between weekly rotations.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="basic-magic-preset"><nowiki>Basic Magic Preset</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643161591571021824.png?v=1" alt="cywirwand" title="cywirwand" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wand of the Cywir Elders</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>Planted feet</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1" alt="pf" title="pf" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656785078160195615.png?v=1" alt="vbook" title="vbook" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Virtus Book</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>Flanking 4</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1" alt="flank4" title="flank4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Seren Godbow</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is used with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339234111848463.png?v=1" alt="ingen" title="ingen" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is optional and can be omitted.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Superior Statius Warhammer</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is used on certain phases.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This is optional, and can be replaced with any main hand melee weapon for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An augmented main hand melee weapon with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502339891331093.png?v=1" alt="as1" title="as1" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be used to avoid losing stacks, if applicable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544200033847869443.png?v=1" alt="aosor" title="aosor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Amulet of Souls</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is a suitable alternative to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544200033390690335.png?v=1" alt="reaperor" title="reaperor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Reaper Necklace</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/PsNY0gx.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="advanced-magic-preset"><nowiki>Advanced Magic Preset</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643161591571021824.png?v=1" alt="cywirwand" title="cywirwand" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wand of the Cywir Elders</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>Planted feet</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501925770919981.png?v=1" alt="pf" title="pf" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/780401412936040478.png?v=1" alt="eofpurple" title="eofpurple" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with Guthix Staff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513203008608141314.png?v=1" alt="gstaff" title="gstaff" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-fight-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>General Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="before-the-fight"><nowiki>Before The Fight</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 6 weekly rotations that cycle every Wednesday at 00:00 Game Time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The six rotations are, in order: Ceiling Collapse (Ceiling) → Scopulus (Scop/Scops) → Vitalis (Vit) → Green Bomb (GB) → Teamsplit (TS) → The End (Purple Bomb/PB)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are three roles at Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Base Tank: Takes melee damage, positions Vorago, and handles various mechanics throughout the fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bomb Tank: Often abbreviated &quot;bt&quot;. Tanks magic damage blue bombs and handles various mechanics throughout the fight.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Not to be confused with other &quot;bt&quot; abbreviations, like Yakamaru's base tank</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Top Lure Voke 5: Often abbreviated as TL5/TLV5, or referred to as the &quot;jump/jumper&quot;. Climbs Vorago on phase 1 and handles the 5th bleed during phases 2 and 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Entry damage is 70% of your max life points regardless of team size.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This damage also cancels defensive abilities, and the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1" alt="EnhancedExcalibur" title="EnhancedExcalibur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> healing effect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513200949016264727.png?v=1" alt="EnhancedExcalibur" title="EnhancedExcalibur" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after taking the entry damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 12s between challenge and entry damage. Advanced players can use this time to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There are 36 ticks from challenging Vorago to Target Cycle, and 35 ticks from the Accept Challenge message to Target Cycle.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Drop down damage is 20 ticks after challenging Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Sample </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> rotation:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JycYCl7.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To time </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, use it 20 ticks after challenging Vorago/accepting challenge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be done by counting each tick from when you challenge by looking at prayer point drain</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It can also be done by looking at the bar above Vorago and clicking on it when it is about to fill, as in the following clip:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA <nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MG00fhlSnKA</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-embed src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/MG00fhlSnKA" title="" allowfullscreen="1" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="during-the-fight"><nowiki>During The Fight</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago has two basic auto attacks: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Melee Swipes</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Blue Bombs</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes target the base tank. They are AoE 1 square around Vorago, and have additional range around the base tank.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Blue bombs are thrown at the furthest player from Vorago, typically the bomb tank. These are homing, deal high magic damage, don't splash, and have a three tile range (7x7) AoE.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago can also do both attacks simultaneously. He will use the animation for a blue bomb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because all of Vorago's attacks are AoE, all members of the team must be conscious of their positioning at all times to prevent unnecessary and unintended damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Diagram of Vorago's attack radii:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/OF84Vp9.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During phases 1-4, Vorago clears </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and regenerates stats almost instantly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This includes defence drains, such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Affinity debuffs will last their full one minute duration.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Advanced players can spam </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to maintain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> uptime.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Phases 1 and 2 are the same regardless of the weekly rotation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's click box spawns in with the boss's animation. As such, Target Cycle can be used to attack Vorago one tick sooner than clicking at the start of every phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be used to damage Vorago before he uses his first attack, including Teamsplits, Waterfalls, and Purple Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ In cases where Vorago becomes invulnerable after his first attack, a fast-hitting ability must be used. Slow-hitting abilities will be nulled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There is a one tick window between phases during which </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1" alt="HealOther" title="HealOther" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used without taking damage. This can be used to mitigate food usage for the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This tick is often referred to as the &quot;crack tick&quot;, as it occurs as the floor is cracking/breaking into the next phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/uWBArh4.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are 17 ticks from the crack tick to the Target Cycle tick.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Target Cycle can be timed by using an ability with a 10s cooldown ability, such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Ensure they are not on cooldown when avoiding Vorago's jumps at the end of each phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Three maul pieces are obtained throughout the fight. The three pieces are combined to create the Maul of Omens. This is used at the end of phase 5 to finish Vorago off.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Maul pieces are dropped during phases 1, 2, and 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Maul pieces can be left on the floor until the end of phase 4 if inventory space is an issue.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Do </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> drop the maul piece on a crack tick. This causes the maul piece to disappear entirely, failing the kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="phase-1"><ins><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="new-special-mechanics"><nowiki>New Special Mechanics</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ New special attack: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Red Bomb</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Thrown at the furthest player away from Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Deals 2k damage in a 2 tile range (5x5)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Cancels defensive abilities and puts them on a short cooldown.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage cannot be blocked or reduced with anything other than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage is increased by 1k for any player standing within a 5 tile radius (11x11) of the target</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Comes with a non homing blue bomb that can be dodged by moving.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Non homing blue has a 3 tile radius (7x7)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Can hit any nearby player, not just the player with the Red Bomb</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EOpDHbN.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="base-tank"><nowiki>Base Tank</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are two ways to lure Vorago on this phase. The beginner method in trio+ teams is to lure Vorago towards the northeast corner so that the TL5 does not receive bombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In this lure method, because the Base Tank is expected to move after the TL5 repositions Vorago, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are less effective. Consider using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533811304497183.png?v=1" alt="meta" title="meta" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/VT5GQZX.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The advanced method is to lure Vorago near the northwest corner to give the TL5 bombs. This is typical in trios, and expected in duos. Care must be taken not to lure Vorago too far west so that the TL5 can provoke Vorago into the right position.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• There is a precise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spot which can be used to line Vorago up with the cliff in case of a bad lure.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand at the west edge of the ultimate if Vorago walks east, and vice versa.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note that in duos, Vorago can throw Blue Bombs at the Base Tank. This chance is increased if Vorago is east of the jump spot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sample Advanced Mage/Ranged Lure P1:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://clips.twitch.tv/CourageousPiercingStarPhilosoraptor <nowiki>https://clips.twitch.tv/CourageousPiercingStarPhilosoraptor</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HORprJx.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In trio+ teams, the Base Tank should use provoke after the TL5 enters the cliff.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Bomb Tank is damaging Vorago on the Target Cycle tick, the Base Tank should account for the one tick later entry into the cliff.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Base Tank can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1" alt="HealOther" title="HealOther" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the Bomb Tank during the jump animation to help the Bomb Tank survive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank's click box will remain at the top of the cliff until the end of the animation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Advanced melee Base Tanks may opt to position Vorago into the proper position for the TL5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Referred to as &quot;solo lure&quot;</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki> for a detailed explanation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Not used by mage and ranged Base Tanks due to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> area limitation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="bomb-tank"><nowiki>Bomb Tank</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In trio+ teams, confirm with the Base Tank on which lure will be used.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If tanking bombs, make sure to keep HP high after entry damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Position </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921119381463070.png?v=1" alt="sunshine" title="sunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> accordingly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The positions are not precise, and have a large margin for error.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/j97kY7v.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Bomb Tank is expected to climb while tanking bombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The damage taken during climb can be extremely high. This is further exacerbated by the inability to eat during climbing animations.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Try to eat to full HP before starting the climb, and eat accordingly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A fast climb is imperative to mitigating damage. See the TL5 section for the expected climbs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because the Bomb Tank also tanks bombs during the jump animation, the Bomb Tank should eat to high HP before jumping.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to block Blue Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Deflect Prayer can be changed once during the jump animation by clicking on the appropriate Deflect Prayer </nowiki><em><nowiki>from the prayer book</nowiki></em><nowiki>. The Deflect Prayer will change as soon as the player hits the ground, and will block damage accordingly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Bomb Tank can also apply a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using the Target Cycle mechanic. This alleviates the Base Tank's rotation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An additional </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537338981747261446.png?v=1" alt="bloodbarrage" title="bloodbarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833358016512.png?v=1" alt="deto" title="deto" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, or stalled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to deal more damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage dealt during climbing animations is nulled. Make sure to delay entry into the cliff by 1 tick to make sure that the damage lands.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Should the damage be nulled, the affinity debuff from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will still apply.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tl5"><nowiki>TL5</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Position next to the cliff on the west side of the arena, and spam click to enter.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago does not move until someone enters the cliff. Entering the cliff on time is important to ensuring the Base Tank's lure.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because the TL5 receives a Red Bomb at the start of the fight, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be used during the climb instead of on entry.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Climbing quickly is an important, but often overlooked skill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In trio+ teams, the limiting factor in the phase is often how quickly the TL5 can position Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In duo teams, fast climbs are required to mitigate damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are three climbs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Slowest, but easiest of the three climbs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Climb Demonstration: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/of6PdOdQBpw <nowiki>https://youtu.be/of6PdOdQBpw</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using the corner cut method</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ More difficult than the previous climb due to the precision of the corner cut Bladed Dive, but faster</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → Corner Cut </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Climb Demonstration: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/tXqfyJwBIyk <nowiki>https://youtu.be/tXqfyJwBIyk</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using the corner cut method</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Most difficult, but fastest climb. Forgoes Powerburst of Vitality, so ample healing is required.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Accel Climb Demonstration: </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/fI0yN5-8HtM <nowiki>https://youtu.be/fI0yN5-8HtM</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Optional: If Vorago is solo lured, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to move directly from the last gap to the jump spot</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Duo Bomb Tank Climb Demonstration with stalled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/2peWQMtrukQ <nowiki>https://youtu.be/2peWQMtrukQ</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Duo Bomb Tank Climb Demonstration with stalled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/756236265472524418.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofacceleration" title="powerburstofacceleration" kind="icon" /><nowiki>:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BSwkMG0o5QU <nowiki>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BSwkMG0o5QU</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-phase-notes"><nowiki>General Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's HP can be lowered to about 13k, but the phase does not end until the jumper jumps.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• HP will &quot;reset&quot; to 80k if it goes under about 13k.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Try to stop attacking at about 25k HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This mechanic also exists on phase 2 before the end of Bring Him Down, and on phase 4 before the final waterfall.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The jumper will receive a maul piece in their inventory once they reach the ground. Therefore, a free inventory space is required to jump.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once the jumper jumps, reduce Vorago's HP to 0 to finish the phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago will jump three times, dealing significant damage any players caught on the landing. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid the jumps.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago can regenerate 1 HP during the jumps. This happens when the instance timer reaches 1:09. While Vorago can be attacked if he regenerates 1 HP, doing so is heavily discouraged.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Some of the unintended consequences include receiving blue bombs during the jumps, and an invisible red bomb that lands at the start of phase 2.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first player to tag Vorago at 1 HP will also hold aggro for the first bleed on phase 2</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="phase-2"><ins><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="new-special-mechanics_1"><nowiki>New Special Mechanics</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ New special attack: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Smash</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;</nowiki><em><nowiki>Bleeds</nowiki></em><nowiki>&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago smashes the ground five times, applying a strong Destroy Tank bleed onto his current target.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Bleed hits deal melee damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleeds can be seen as a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879376023572.png?v=1" alt="dismember" title="dismember" kind="icon" /><nowiki> icon on the player's debuff bar.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each tick of bleed damage cancels defensive abilities, and thus cannot be used to block damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tanking a second bleed without clearing a previous bleed results in a 6k typeless hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleeds can be cleared with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and distance from Vorago. Distance can be created using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Bleeds are cleared at 7+ tiles away from Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Distance Bleed clears should be done as close to tick perfect as possible, just before taking damage from the first Bleed tick. This maximizes the amount of time the next player has to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleeds can be distance cleared with a simultaneous </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to prevent Vorago from moving.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is tick perfect, just before taking damage from the first Bleed tick.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should be aimed with Vorago as the target, not the ground.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Clearing Bleeds with a diagonal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may cause Vorago to move.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago always throws a blue bomb with his third Bleed, but otherwise does not attack during this time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ New special attack: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Reflect</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Also known as &quot;Link&quot;, and is used interchangeably with Reflect</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago targets one player for 15 ticks. Any damage dealt to Vorago during this time is instead redirected to the targeted player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Abilities do not deal their normal damage, and instead tend to deal more damage than usual.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879359377439.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can hit over 20k damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Most bleeds and abilities activated before Reflect that would hit into Reflect are nulled instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Abilities that would land on the tick the Reflect message appears still deal damage to Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ An ability bled with the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> special effect will </nowiki><em><nowiki>not</nowiki></em><nowiki> be nulled, and instead will damage players during reflect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If you currently have the FSOA </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869284271595069451.png?v=1" alt="soa" title="soa" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spec active, equip your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> switch to ensure no autos are fired during reflect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_1"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/pPNE2a2.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-phase-notes_1"><nowiki>General Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Phase 2 is time gated. In order to progress the phase, Vorago must absorb at least two Gravity Orbs, which spawn on Reflect. Thus, at least two Reflect special attacks are required.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Since this phase is time gated, use as many defensives as necessary to avoid using food at all during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because this phase is time gated, damage dealt is largely irrelevant. The only notable damage benchmark is to reduce Vorago's HP to under 25k before the final Reflect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• DPS ultimates can be skipped. However, they can be used for anyone competing for drops.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1" alt="stormshards" title="stormshards" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and use affinity-increasing abilities to increase hit chance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Up to 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256663641128971.png?v=1" alt="stormshards" title="stormshards" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be thrown per player. An additional one can be thrown during Bring Him Down.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="smash-bleed-notes"><nowiki>Smash Bleed Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At the start of the phase, the Base Tank should still hold aggro from phase 1. He should receive the first Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If someone else tagged Vorago at 1 HP from the previous phase, that person will instead receive the first bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• 1 HP aggro can be overridden with Target Cycle. Because a properly-timed Target Cycle ability will attack Vorago before he uses his first Bleed, aggro will shift to the Target Cycling player.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Base Tank should always Target Cycle this phase to ensure the first bleed if possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ A Vulnerability Bomb can be used in place of Target Cycle to allow for more lenient timing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ All other players should avoid Target Cycle.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The first Bleed of this phase does not have an animation. It occurs as soon as Vorago's feet touch the floor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago will then randomly aggro any member of the team, including the Base Tank. The Base Tank should use Provoke after Freedom to ensure aggro for the second Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Base Tank should clear the first two Bleeds using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank should use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after the second bleed, and clear the third and fourth Bleeds with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago always throws a Blue Bomb with the third Bleed. Because the Base Tank just used </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, this Blue Bomb should always go to the Base Tank. Save </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for this Blue Bomb, as it is a guaranteed heal.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The TL5 should use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after the fourth Bleed and clear the fifth Bleed with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Bomb Tank takes the fifth bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Either the third or fourth bleed should be cleared with an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/qDzuH08.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Otherwise, the Bomb Tank should </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the third Bleed, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the fourth Bleed, and:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Step one tile forward if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> was used with a magic weapon (8-tile range).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Step two tiles forward if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> was used with most 2H ranged weapons (9-tile range).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stand still if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> was used with dual wield ranged weapons (7-tile range).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Optionally, the Base Tank can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> clear the fifth Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Useful if the Bomb Tank uses </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> early and tanks Bleeds 2-4 instead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players should stand melee distance when using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid moving Vorago from Base Spot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players can easily move to melee distance by:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Stepping under Vorago, then using a non-channeled ability</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Equipping a melee weapon and clicking on Vorago</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Barging in</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="gravity-orb-notes"><nowiki>Gravity Orb Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>At the start of every Reflect, Vorago will spawn a Gravity Orb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Clicking on a Gravity Orb will cause Vorago to absorb it.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A total of 2 Gravity Orbs are required to finish the phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If a Gravity Orb is not clicked before the next Reflect, a second Gravity Orb will not spawn. Vorago must use an additional Reflect to spawn the required 2 Gravity orbs. This should be avoided.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gravity Orbs have limited range. Vorago must be close enough to each Gravity Orb, or the orb will not be absorbed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are two positions in the middle of the arena referred to as &quot;Base Spot&quot;. In these spots, Vorago is close enough to every Gravity Orb spawn such that he does not have to move at all during the phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Base Tank should lure Vorago into Base Spot on the first or second bleed by standing two or three squares south of the L crack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Base Spot three south of the L crack is slightly better, as it allows a north side Base Tank to tag the middle Gravity Orb without moving Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/SnxgXKm.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ See </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki> for instructions on how to recenter Vorago if he moves from Base Spot.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="red-bomb-notes"><nowiki>Red Bomb Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because Red Bombs cancel defensive abilities and put them on cooldown, the Bomb Tank can take significant damage during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727985851891715.png?v=1" alt="HealOther" title="HealOther" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is commonly used during Red Bombs to mitigate damage and food usage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Either the Base Tank or the Bomb Tank will use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the Red Bomb</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank can force the Red Bomb onto someone else if they are going to use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ To force a Red Bomb, the Bomb Tank should move closer to Vorago so that someone else is the furthest player from Vorago. Start moving immediately after the third attack during Reflect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ In duos, the Bomb Tank will need to move either melee distance or underneath Vorago to force the Red Bomb onto the Base Tank.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="bring-him-down-and-transition-into-p3"><nowiki>Bring Him Down And Transition Into P3</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the last Gravity Orb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> must be used during the final Bleed clears to ensure that </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are off cooldown for the final Gravity Orb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The phase will progress into Bring Him Down (BHD), during which all players spam click Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once the bar at the top fills, Vorago will stumble. The team must deal a collective 50k damage to free the next maul piece.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This portion is 20 ticks long.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is blocking during this time. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is guaranteed to land 5 arrows.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rangers should switch to bolts other than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1" alt="RubyBakri" title="RubyBakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1" alt="RubyBakri" title="RubyBakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs will deal damage based on Vorago's low HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Reequip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1" alt="RubyBakri" title="RubyBakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before the start of phase 3.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago's defence is significantly reduced during this time, allowing players to reach 100% hit chance quite easily.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage dealt during this time does not affect Vorago's HP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615618531937222657.png?v=1" alt="ecb" title="ecb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage does not count towards the 50k damage threshold, and instead will damage Vorago's HP bar instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is useful if Vorago's HP is still high.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Failing the 50k damage threshold causes Vorago to regenerate a large amount of HP. An additional 2 Gravity Orbs are required to progress the phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
