<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="clone-skip-notes_1"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank cannot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> both Red Bombs. The Base Tank should </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> one of them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1" alt="ancientrepriser" title="ancientrepriser" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) then the Bomb Tank can do both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1" alt="malletops" title="malletops" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p4-vitalis"><ins><nowiki>P4: Vitalis</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_9"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/fbsKV1l.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_8"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vitalis Orbs will always be north, east, or northeast if not doing Clone Skip, assuming Vorago does not move from the centre of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The team should move to the northeast during the 7 auto attacks after the Stone Clone to prepare for the Vitalis Orb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Killing the Vitali that spawn is top priority, as they cause a number of pathing problems.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to help with Vitali, though they only deal 4k damage each.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="clone-skip-notes_2"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Bomb Tank cannot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> both Vitalis Orbs. The Base Tank should </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> one of them.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1" alt="ancientrepriser" title="ancientrepriser" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) then the Bomb Tank can do both </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1" alt="malletops" title="malletops" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Due to the alternating </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ample DPS on both Vorago and Vitali are required from both the Base and Bomb Tanks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because Vorago moves from the centre of the room, the direction of the Vitalis orbs are random.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p4-green-bomb"><ins><nowiki>P4: Green Bomb</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_10"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/P7qduyh.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_9"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Green Bomb principles from phase 3 apply to phase 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tanking the Green Bomb instead of passing it is preferable.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While there are normally five auto attacks after a Green Bomb, tanking the Green Bomb shortens this to three auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Passing before tanking the Green Bomb leads to a longer phase, and can have undesirable effects.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Since this is a time gated phase, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to block the 10k damage from the Green Bomb.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Green Bomb is NOT on the Bomb Tank: the Bomb Tank should </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the Green Bomb IS on the Bomb Tank: the Base Tank should </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="clone-skip-notes_3"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Neither the Base Tank nor the Bomb Tank can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> both Green Bombs assuming the use of Turtling 4.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Base Tank should be prepared to tank a 10k with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and/or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if either role receives both Green Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• However, if no form of Turtling is used (e.g., </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643150658891153428.png?v=1" alt="ancientrepriser" title="ancientrepriser" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) then the a player can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> both if needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Take caution if you do not have Malletops </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/690136117374484508.png?v=1" alt="malletops" title="malletops" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> extension as it may mean your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> would be shorter than Intercept </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p4-teamsplit"><ins><nowiki>P4: Teamsplit</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_11"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/qj6rlQa.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_10"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after Teamsplit if the additional damage reduction + Heal Other are required. Otherwise, this can be skipped.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Like phase 3, Teamsplits can be broken during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unlike phase 3, Broken Teamsplits are beneficial during this phase because they alleviate some of the time gate.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bleed a melee ability using the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> effect just before the Teamsplit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Any melee ability affected by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> works.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Splashing does not matter, so anyone can break Teamsplits regardless of primary combat style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The optimal timing is to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> one tick after the 6th Blue Bomb, then bleeding an ability immediately after.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure the team is aware of this strategy's use, as it can kill unsuspecting players.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Vorago will throw Blue Bombs during Teamsplit with no animation. In addition, if Vorago is standing next to a player, he can also melee swipe.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="clone-skip-notes_4"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Since </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is optional this week, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cooldown does not play a large factor during this week.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If Clone Skip is paired with Broken Teamsplits, the amount of time the team has to DPS is much shorter than normal. Make sure the team has enough DPS to clear the phase on time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ The optimal timing for Broken Teamsplit with Clone Skip is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689501908628799488.png?v=1" alt="mob" title="mob" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879250456578.png?v=1" alt="gbarge" title="gbarge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immediately off cooldown → wait 1 tick → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879283879977.png?v=1" alt="gflurry" title="gflurry" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p4-the-end"><ins><nowiki>P4: The End</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_12"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/REPpAAF.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_11"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because this phase is time gated, defensive abilities can be used to mitigate most or all of the damage during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Base Tank should tag all of the Red Bombs during this phase, while the Bomb Tank should use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Heal Other on the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ On Vorago's stand, the Base Tank should use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When Vorago throws his Red Bomb, the Base Tank should do one of the following:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the Bomb Tank again using the remaining </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> duration (Malletops + T90 Shield </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Turtling 3 only)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki> the Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Move melee distance and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reduce the number of Blue Bombs the Bomb Tank receives.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the Base Tank and Bomb Tank reverse their </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> order, the Bomb Tank's </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may be on cooldown at the start of phase 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="clone-skip-notes_5"><nowiki>Clone Skip Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Due to phase length, Clone Skip is largely unaffected by </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timing. The </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> strategy without Clone Skip still applies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Turtling 4 prevents players from using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on time. Turtling 3 is recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="transition-into-phase-5"><ins><nowiki>Transition into Phase 5</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="end-of-p4"><nowiki>End of P4</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's HP should be lowered before the third Waterfall. Ideally, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1" alt="shatter" title="shatter" kind="icon" /><nowiki> should finish Vorago off.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be thrown to aid this.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641670143197446182.png?v=1" alt="swh" title="swh" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used some time before the last Waterfall to aid with hit chance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Rangers should use bolts other than </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1" alt="RubyBakri" title="RubyBakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/536256673904328704.png?v=1" alt="shatter" title="shatter" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. Reequip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489413287956.png?v=1" alt="RubyBakri" title="RubyBakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki> before the start of phase 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The mauler should pick up the first two maul pieces </nowiki><em><nowiki>before</nowiki></em><nowiki> the third waterfall.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The default maul player, unless otherwise specified, is: any melee player → TL5 (trio+) → Bomb Tank (duo)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Like the transition from phase 2 to phase 3, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used to build additional adrenaline from a dummy.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The ideal dummy position is close to the center of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timing is largely the same as the phase 2 → phase 3 transition</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Facing direction is preserved between phases. The Bomb Tank can start a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> rotation facing east, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> during global cooldown on phase 5 to place a melee distance </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921434633744455.png?v=1" alt="deathsswift" title="deathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Avoid using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on t-15, as it causes some strange loading issues.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The third maul piece spawns on the floor near Vorago after the third Waterfall. A red dot on the minimap can be used to help find the maul piece.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="phase-5"><ins><nowiki>Phase 5</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="new-special-mechanics_9"><nowiki>New Special Mechanics</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>New special arena: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Pushing Vorago</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago spawns in the middle of a long and narrow phase 5 arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago covers the width of the arena and is blocking, preventing access to the eastern side of Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits Vorago as if he were a blocking entity.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players must push Vorago eight tiles east from his starting position, then use the Maul of Omens.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players can push Vorago one tile east by dealing about 20k damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;push&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The damage threshold is more complex than this. For a detailed explanation, see </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago will push players backward by dealing damage to the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;push back&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push back is not relative to the amount of damage players receive.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each attack has its own value push back value.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Melee Swipes and Blue Bombs push back the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In duos and trios, this number is always one tile of push back for every successful hit.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In teams of 4+, this may not always hold true.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee swipes only occur if at least one player is standing within melee distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because Vorago can use both his melee swipe and Blue Bomb in a single auto attack, players may receive two squares of push back in a single auto attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• AoE damage can affect push back.*</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Only a limited number of defensive options can prevent push back from auto attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Blocks all push back from auto attacks during its duration)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Blocks all push back from a single auto attack)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1" alt="sd" title="sd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Blocks half a tile of push back per auto attack while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537341954392850442.png?v=1" alt="sd" title="sd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active. Only occurs at 50% damage reduction. Recommended only during Reflect.)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (Blocks half a tile of push back per auto attack while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is active. Not recommended.)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All other defensive options (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> etc) do not affect push back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some of Vorago's special attacks push back the team.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage from PKing on Reflect will cause push back. The amount of push back varies on the ability and damage dealt.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tanking melee bleed ticks from Vorago's Smash will cause push back. The amount of push back per tick of damage is 1/team size (e.g. duos is 1/2 tile per tick of damage)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• See the weekly rotation sections below for other sources of push back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Only one tile of push and push back per tick can occur.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Push and push back can occur on the same tick.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because only one tile of push back can occur, an auto attack hitting multiple players will still only push back one tile.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• An auto attack that hits multiple players can only be blocked if </nowiki><em><nowiki>all</nowiki></em><nowiki> players are under the effects of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. If even one person receives damage, the auto attack will cause push back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago will slightly raise his defence level for each tile Vorago is pushed east past the starting point.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/b5itISX.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-phase-notes_4"><nowiki>General Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Maul of Omens can be created by clicking any of the maul pieces while all three are in the mauler's inventory.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once Vorago is at the eastern edge of the arena, use the Maul of Omens within halberd range by clicking on the maul.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After the first auto attack, Vorago's attack speed changes to once every three ticks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago no longer clears </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after this point.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago cannot attack on the same tick he is pushed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The next Blue Bomb will be at least 3 ticks after he is pushed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Players can stall Vorago's attack rotation indefinitely by pushing Vorago at least once every three ticks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is commonly known as &quot;stall&quot; and &quot;stalling&quot;.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ With a strong, well-timed rotation, teams can completely prevent Vorago from attacking.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Finishing this phase before Reflect, or even the first special attack is possible. These are known as 0 link and 0 spec phases respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These strategies employ more aggressive rotations, which usually include the Bomb Tank skipping </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for a damage boosting ultimate. However, these strategies can be slower if the phase does not finish before Reflect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ List of stall durations:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago is pushed: 3 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago pushes back (any source): 6 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Vorago uses a special attack:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Purple Bomb: 5 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Green Bomb: 10 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Teamsplit: 4 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Vitalis: 4 ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stall duration is overwritten by the most recent cause of stall.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• e.g. If Vorago throws a Green Bomb on tick 1, and Vorago is pushed on tick 2, Vorago will throw a blue bomb on tick 5. The push stall duration overwrites the Green Bomb stall duration.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because the arena is narrow, players must be careful about preventing AoE damage from Blue Bombs.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank should be on the northern edge of the arena, while the rest of the team should be on the southern edge. This prevents Blue Bombs from dealing AoE damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can mitigate some push back, players are highly recommended avoiding it. See </nowiki>[https://pvme.io/pvme-guides/rs3-full-boss-guides/vorago/tips-and-tricks/#skipping-debilitate-on-p5 <nowiki>this page</nowiki>]<nowiki> for a detailed explanation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's aggro is random and cannot be controlled.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> cannot be activated on Vorago during this phase.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vorago's Smash attack is only three smashes long, rather than five.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Because aggro is random, all players must be ready to clear Bleeds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Distance Bleed clears on this phase are determined by distance from where the player received the bleed, not distance from Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> towards Vorago from the far west is an option for Bleed clears.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ If a Bleed is received in an undesirable spot (roughly half way between Vorago and the west side of the arena), there may not be enough distance in either direction to clear the bleed. If this happens, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMelee" title="DeflectMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, tank the entire Bleed duration, and DPS as much as possible.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dual crossbow range </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is occasionally not enough to clear Bleeds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Players should </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with a 2-handed ranged weapon, or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> instead.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There are three ways to clear a triple Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Standard Method: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Easier to execute</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spends two abilities that deal little damage (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Advanced Method: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Difficult to execute losslessly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Spends only one ability that deals little damage (</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki>), and only if a player receives all three Bleeds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Mages will need to turn their run off after </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to ensure enough distance to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Rangers will need to camp a 2H weapon to ensure enough distance to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Alternative Advanced Method: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854281764884.png?v=1" alt="bd" title="bd" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Difficult to execute losslessly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Helps meleers stay melee distance during Bleed clears</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The primary </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timing is when the first Blue Bomb lands, after Vorago's weekly special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This can be delayed to the second Blue Bomb if using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the team expects more than one weekly special attack, the Bomb Tank and Base Tank swap positions immediately after Vorago's third Bleed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The time between weekly special attacks is too short for one player to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> two consecutive weekly special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There is an earlier Base Tank </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> timing, after Smash but before Vorago's weekly special attack.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Commonly referred to as &quot;early cade&quot;</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Used if the team can finish the phase before or on the weekly special attack release.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p5-ceiling-collapseteamsplit"><ins><nowiki>P5: Ceiling Collapse/Teamsplit</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_13"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/g3Cgab3.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_12"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ceiling Collapse does not have its own unique phase 5 mechanic, and instead uses the Teamsplit phase 5 mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Tanking the 8k damage from Teamsplit does not cause push back, and can be used as a reliable source of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462694912.png?v=1" alt="Reprisal" title="Reprisal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because Teamsplits cancel defensive abilities and put them on cooldown, the last Blue Bomb before Teamsplit usually cannot be blocked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Unaware players may try to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> this Blue Bomb at low HP without Deflect Magic, potentially receiving fatal damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Early </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is not used on this rotation.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p5-scopulusthe-end"><ins><nowiki>P5: Scopulus/The End</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_14"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/gg1VugJ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_13"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Scopulus does not have its own unique phase 5 mechanic, and instead uses the &quot;The End&quot; phase 5 mechanic.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Purple Bombs do not cause push back if they only hit their designated targets.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Each Purple Bomb causes one tile of push back if they deal AoE damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Purple Bomb timers are counted in ticks, not seconds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Purple Bomb timers are always at least 5 ticks apart. Two Purple Bombs will never explode at the same time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In duos, the Purple Bomb can largely be ignored since players are already separated from each other.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In trios, the Base Tank does not stand near south edge like usual. The Base Tank instead stands near the north edge, and close to Vorago.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Since the Bomb Tank is also north, the Base Tank and Bomb Tank should watch their distance from each other.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trio positioning:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HBbgO5g.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In teams of 4+, all members except the Bomb Tank stand on the south wall. Each player should run north when the timer reaches 5 ticks, wait for the Purple Bomb to explode, then run back south.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The number of Purple Bombs is capped, so not every person may receive one in large teams.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p5-vitalis"><ins><nowiki>P5: Vitalis</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_15"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/46qliKG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_14"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vitalis Orbs always cause push back if at least one player is standing in the Vitalis Orb explosion.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vitalis Orbs do not cause push back if no one is standing in the Vitalis Orb explosion.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During this phase, Vitalis Orbs spawn 2-4 Vitali instead of 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Vitali melee attacks cause push back. The amount of push back per Vitali melee attack is 1/team size.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players will inexplicably change targets to Vorago when targeting Vitali. This can be especially detrimental during Reflect.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be preplaced to help deal with Vitali.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are mutually exclusive with most </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> rotations because </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> count as valid targets.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This phase can be extremely difficult in duos. Teams without sufficient DPS will struggle to generate enough push to counteract the guaranteed Vitalis Orb push back, and the push back from Vitali.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="p5-green-bomb"><ins><nowiki>P5: Green Bomb</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="voragos-attack-rotation_16"><nowiki>Vorago's Attack Rotation</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/GXSm3mQ.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-notes_15"><nowiki>Phase Notes</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The 10k hit from tanking Green Bombs without passing causes push back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The 1k AoE damage from passing Green Bombs causes push back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Passing a Green Bomb without dealing AoE damage does not cause push back.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because tanking Green Bombs forces Vorago into Reflect, and Vorago's attacks can be stalled for an indeterminate amount of time, the number of Blue Bombs between the Green Bomb launch and reflect can be anywhere from 0 to 5.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Because this is the only week during which Blue Bombs can be skipped with more DPS, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258131865633.png?v=1" alt="nat" title="nat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is highly recommended.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As with previous phases, the preferred method of handling the Green Bomb is to tank the 10k damage with a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In duos, players should already be on opposite sides of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In trios, the TL5 should be on the south edge, while the Bomb Tank and Base Tank should be on the north edge.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The Base and Bomb Tanks should take extra care not to pass the Green Bomb between each other, as they are both on the north edge of the arena.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Trio positioning:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HBbgO5g.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In teams of 4+, everyone but the Bomb Tank should stand on the south edge. The player with the Green Bomb should run to the north edge, tank the 10k hit, and run back south.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While the Green Bomb is normally followed by a long delay in Vorago's attacks, this only happens for the first Green Bomb. Subsequent Green Bombs will be followed by Blue Bombs in quick succession.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The Bomb Tank must be at a higher HP than usual to tank subsequent Green Bombs with a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• A Bomb Tank cannot survive subsequent Green Bombs on his own without a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Should the phase last this long, the onus lies on the Base Tank to save the Bomb Tank.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The preferred method to deal with this situation is </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434509357098.png?v=1" alt="Cept" title="Cept" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>For those interested in reading up on more Vorago-related information and theorycrafting, take a look at Rago Hub and their wealth of knowledge: </nowiki>[https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH <nowiki>https://discord.gg/uqGJbKH</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
      
    </nowiki>

</div>
</div>
